question: Israel military action against Lebanon on October 26?
resolution_criteria: Yes if an Israeli air strike or surface-to-surface missile strike directly impacts Lebanon on October 26, 2026, Jerusalem time. Resolves with Polymarket market israel-military-action-against-lebanon-on-october-26.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 84.5% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes per the Polymarket market. Our last number was 84.5%, the market's at entry 84.5%. The longshot rule made no difference on this one.
